value.the_domain_is_flatter_than_the_metaphor: 13 of 18 in one band, so FINE-GRAINED ORDERING BUYS ALMOST NOTHING and the four-band first cut was one band too many for what exists. The node is not falsified — it is right-sized. What survives is smaller and better: the coarse band is a PRECONDITION GATE, and that is the payoff. Today a component with no charter still generates thirteen findings about its chart packets; banded, those thirteen go ABSENT rather than noisy, which is the whole not-applicable rule doing real work on real output.
value.the_off_box_band_is_empty_and_that_is_no: CC first proposed a tooth that would RED an off-box sieve in the build gate, and Akien refused it as a current state written as a law — the same correction he made that morning about self-inspection, repeated by CC in the same session. THERE ARE ALREADY TWO HOSTS (this box and Hex), and in TheIgors era FOUR laptops, each with a copy of the database (this box master, the rest failover), each running one Igor instance with four centers of awareness against local 3b/7b Ollama on ten-minute timeouts, overnight. His words: 'will we do that? I don't know. but we CAN.' So the off-box band's job is SEQUENCING, NOT PROHIBITION: when an off-box sieve arrives it runs last, and an unreachable host cannot mask a local finding. The emptiness is a fact about today's corpus, never a rule about the world. NOTE THE FIT: the learning-block anatomy already reserves the slot — candidate questions come from feedback and LLM processing 'probably in the evenings' — and a slow local host on a ten-minute budget is exactly what an evening pass is for. The expensive sieves run off-box overnight, the cheap ones at every crossing, and the band is what keeps the two from being confused.

value.THE_PAYOFF_CLAIM_WAS_FALSE: This ticket said a charterless component still emits thirteen findings about its chart packets, and named that as what the precondition band would buy. MEASURED FALSE 2026-08-06: the thirteen chart judges hang off _component_tickets(), which reads history.json and returns an empty set when it is absent — so a charterless component already emits nothing from them. The live sweep is 1 finding over 24 components. The claim was reasoned from true premises without opening the code, which is the exact failure shape this corpus already has a name for. NO SUPPRESSION IS WIRED: the report's shape carries not-applicable (a sieve the nest did not shake is ABSENT from the gradation, never 0.0) and nothing suppresses, because no measured case wants it. Wire it when a real one appears.
value.a_guard_was_a_coin_toss: The inspector's tree-free tooth scanned raw source for a tree door's NAME. import_sieve is the module that exposes it: it NAMES cairn.machines.chart.tree as ladder data while importing nothing. Now asked of the IMPORTS, with the name-scan kept for exactly the hole an AST cannot see — skill_block genuinely imports dynamically, so it still pays the coarse check; a module without that capability does not. Mention is not capability, arriving in the guard rather than in the thing guarded.
value.not_renamed_on_purpose: diagnostic_inspector. Its filters are selection predicates (predicate(record) -> bool, conjoined) that PICK records; they do not judge, carry no mesh, emit no finding, form no nest. Renaming them would give 'sieve' two meanings and blur the ruling. Flagged rather than decided silently — Akien can overrule.
